[229] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā . evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro . [230] kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbāna- poṇo nibbānapabbhāro . idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ .pe. sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ . evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti . [231] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave yamunā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā . evameva kho bhikkhave .pe. [232] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave aciravatī nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā . evameva kho bhikkhave .pe.
